verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is a commerce platform that offers event-driven automation such as webhooks, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The pack has no evidence of version history, review, or rollback for webhooks or any other automation. REST API namespace versioning (v1/v2/v3) concerns the API itself, not the user's automations, so it does not transfer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
